info.Title: Departmment of Pharmaceuticals Public Notice dated 18.12.2021 for Identification of local manufactureres of medical devices

text: 401583/2021/BE-II 121 F.No. 31026/180/2021-MD Government of India Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers Department of Pharmaceuticals *** Public Notice dated 18.12.2021 Subiect: Inviting details of local manufacturers of specific medical devices/equipment-reg. The Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) has issued the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) (PPP-MII) Order, 2017 dated 16.09.2020. In pursuance of the same, the Department of Pharmaceuticals had issued guidelines dated 16.02.2021 for implementation of the Order related to procurement of goods and services in Medical Devices. Both the orders can be accessed on the website of the Department at https://pharmaceuticals.gov .in/pol icy 2. Various representations have been received from procuring agencies under the Government of India with regard to non-availability of Class-I or Class-II suppliers for identified Medical Devices/Equipment. An exercise was done to ascertain the local manufacturers from different sources for these identified Medical Devices/Equipment including the domestic manufacturers association. 3. However, recognising that the manufacturers of the identified medical devices may be spread across the country and may not be member of any manufacturers association and also to give a reasonable opportunity, the said medical devices/equipment, as received from the procurement agencies, are being put in public domain at Annexure-1 and Annexure-11 to collect details of local manufacturers. 4. The following details are invited from the local manufacturers of items in Annexure-I and Annexure-II for smooth implementation of the Public Procurement Policy which gives preference to domestic manufacturers with sufficient local content. a. Name of the manufacturing entity -- 1 of 43 -- 401583/2021/BE-II 122 - l- b. Address of the Registered Office and Manufacturing location (complete postal address) c. Contact Details email id and phone numbers (Mobile and Office) d. Local Content percentage of the medical device. e. Specifications of the medical device equipment f. Whether registered with GeM portal. 5. It is to inform that any local manufacturers of the Medical Devices/Equipment in the Annexures, especially Annexure-1 are requested to share the above details to the mail id - pppmii-dop@gov.in latest by 31.12.2021. If no information is received by the due date, further action will be taken, arriving that local manufacturers are not available for these medical devices/equipment. 6. If any details of the specifications of these medical devices/equipment are required, same may be obtained by mailing to the following ids of Procuring Agencies. a. Central Medical Service Society ofMoHFW at gmproc.cmss@gmail.com b. Employees State Insurance Corporation of Mio Labour at dmc- procurement.hq@esic.ni c. in c.
